note: GSTA-152 plan item 8. Per-meter constants for /ship budget projections, fitted conservatively from metered runs: each constant is the largest observation times `headroom`, rounded up to `round_to` (lib/ship-budget.ts fitConstant). test/ship-budget-calibration.test.ts checks the constants equal the fit and that a leave-one-out fit on two runs is at or above the meter on the third. Savings claims count completed ships only. Each unit's call_floor (GSTA-167) is the host's per-call floor: what one call costs in a fresh session with the ship skill loaded, before any /ship work. The delegate thresholds compare the per-call charge minus this floor, so a host's own system prompt and tools never trigger delegation. A floor is the largest round_to multiple at or below its smallest observed fresh call, so it never hides real context growth; start --call-floor <n> overrides it for one run.

per_call.source: GSTA-152 plan v3 evidence: late parent calls charged 0.22M then 0.24M (solved from the 29.3M and 16.3M counter windows; derived)
GSTA-152 plan v3 evidence: late turns cost about 0.4M each (root counter read after every step)
GSTA-152 plan v3 evidence: the /ship child's context was about 0.5M per call at the handoff

per_dispatch.source: GSTA-152 plan v3 evidence: about 2.4M per child, solved from the two counter windows (derived)
GSTA-152 plan v3 evidence: the /ship child and its 10 review dispatches account for about 49.5M (4-5M per dispatch)

stop_overhead.source: GSTA-152 plan v3 evidence: the stop message and the parent's checks took the counter from 39.40M to 41.05M

capy-tokens.fit: observations above (Capy root counter, children included)
capy-tokens.call_floor_why: GSTA-2 (gstack 1.91.320.0, gstack-evals #35/#36): a fresh Capy thread's first counter reading is about 98k (host system prompt and tools) and every call with the ship skill loaded costs 150-230k before any /ship work; 150k is the smallest observed call. Below it, DELEGATE_START_CALL (100k) fired on every capped Capy start and DELEGATE_SEGMENT_CALL (150k) stopped two #36 children at their first boundary.

claude-usage-tokens.why: no Claude Code-metered /ship yet; refit once one completes
claude-usage-tokens.call_floor_why: GSTA-167 measurement, 2026-10-29: Claude Code 2.1.312 on claude-opus-5-5 with gstack's 64 skills listed, metered as this meter does (input + cache_creation + cache_read + output per message): the first call of a fresh -p session cost 19,225 and the call after reading ship/SKILL.md in full cost 46,379. One observation, so the floor rounds down to 40k; refit once a Claude-metered /ship completes.

estimate-tokens.why: the estimate meter projects with the Capy fit, which is at or above the meter on the metered runs
estimate-tokens.call_floor_why: The estimate meter takes no readings, so its per-call charge is always unknown and the floor has nothing to subtract: an unknown charge keeps the pre-floor rule (delegate at a segment boundary, never at start).
